__inputs.description: Choose the PostgreSQL datasource connected to your Observatory TimescaleDB database.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), COALESCE(NULLIF(source_id, ''), 'Device ' || device_id, 'Unknown source') AS metric, avg(bpm) AS value
FROM heart_rate
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Heart Rate
panels.description: Average heart rate in each interval, grouped by source.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), COALESCE(NULLIF(source_id, ''), 'Device ' || device_id, 'Unknown source') AS metric, avg(value_ms) AS value
FROM hrv
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
  AND algorithm = 'sdnn'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Heart Rate Variability (SDNN)
panels.description: Average Apple Health HRV (SDNN) in each interval, grouped by source.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), COALESCE(NULLIF(source_id, ''), 'Device ' || device_id, 'Unknown source') AS metric, avg(spo2_pct) AS value
FROM blood_oxygen
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Blood Oxygen
panels.description: Average blood oxygen saturation in each interval, grouped by source.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time, max(steps) AS steps
FROM daily_activity
WHERE date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
  AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
  AND owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
  AND steps IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily Steps
panels.description: Highest reported step total for each day. Totals from different sources are never added.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily_source AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', start_time, 'UTC') AS time,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(source_id, ''), 'Device ' || device_id, 'Unknown source') AS source, sum(total_duration_ms) / 3600000.0 AS hours
  FROM sleep_sessions
  WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
    AND owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
    AND total_duration_ms IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), ranked AS (
  SELECT time, hours, row_number() OVER (
    PARTITION BY time ORDER BY CASE WHEN hours BETWEEN 0 AND 16 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, hours DESC
  ) AS rn
  FROM daily_source
)
SELECT time, round(LEAST(hours, 16)::numeric, 2) AS sleep_hours
FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sleep Duration
panels.description: Daily sleep duration from one source per day, grouped by the UTC start date.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, bpm AS value
FROM heart_rate
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
ORDER BY time DESC, device_id
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Latest Heart Rate
panels.description: Most recent heart rate reading in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, value_ms AS value
FROM hrv
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
  AND algorithm = 'sdnn'
ORDER BY time DESC, device_id
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Latest HRV (SDNN)
panels.description: Most recent Apple Health HRV reading (SDNN) in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time, max(steps) AS value
FROM daily_activity
WHERE date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
  AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
  AND owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
  AND steps IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Latest Daily Steps
panels.description: Highest reported total on the latest day with steps in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (
  (SELECT count(*) FROM heart_rate WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
  + (SELECT count(*) FROM hrv WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
  + (SELECT count(*) FROM blood_oxygen WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
  + (SELECT count(*) FROM daily_activity WHERE date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
  AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AND owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
  + (SELECT count(*) FROM sleep_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
  + (SELECT count(*) FROM workouts WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
  + (SELECT count(*) FROM quantity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
) AS value

panels.title: Records Ingested
panels.description: Counts stored heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen, daily activity, sleep, workout, and other quantity records in the selected range, including overlapping sources.

title: Apple Health (HealthSave Observatory)
description: Chart Apple Health data synced by the HealthSave iPhone app to your self-hosted HealthSave Observatory. Requires a PostgreSQL datasource connected to the Observatory's TimescaleDB database and data synced for the primary person. https://healthsave.app/observatory/ | https://github.com/umutkeltek/healthsave-observatory
